title: Long Xuyen, An Giang — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Long Xuyen, An Giang: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Long Xuyen is a city in An Giang with a population of 280,000. A Mekong Delta city known for its floating markets and riverside life, offering one of the lowest costs of living in all of Vietnam. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
